note: Frame options dealt by scripts/deal.mjs. Each option is a pattern seen working on reference-tier startup sites or in the person-judged bake-off; none is a default. 'fits' lists the lanes it suits; an empty list means any lane. 'weight' is how often an option is dealt relative to others: 3 for options a person preferred in blind checks, 1 for untested, 0.3 for options that lost; 'not_for' lists lanes where it lost. Update after every person-judged check.

nav.name: Floating pill
nav.what: A pill detached 16–24px from the top, centred, as wide as its contents, with a hairline and a soft blurred background.

nav.name: Hairline bar
nav.what: A full-width bar on the hero's own ground: wordmark left, links and one action right, a 1px hairline underneath, turning solid once the page scrolls.

nav.name: Split corners
nav.what: No bar: the wordmark in the top-left corner, one action in the top-right, links behind a Menu button or in a quiet second row.

nav.name: Docs bar
nav.what: A compact bar in the manner of a docs site: wordmark, Docs, Pricing, Changelog, and Install or Get a key as the action; links are plain text, the action a small solid button.

nav.name: Side rail
nav.what: From 1200px, a thin vertical rail on the left holds the wordmark and section links, with the action pinned at its foot; on smaller screens, a plain top bar.

hero.name: Editorial split
hero.what: Large type in the left half; the picture and one example card on the right, overlapping slightly, one tilted 2–3°.

hero.name: Centred poster
hero.what: Headline, sentence and buttons centred; a wide picture below them, rising into view and bleeding off the bottom of the first screen.

hero.name: Full-bleed picture
hero.what: The picture fills the screen; the headline and buttons sit on its calmest area, with a soft scrim only if contrast needs it.

hero.name: Card cascade
hero.what: Headline left; two or three product cards stacked in depth on the right, slightly rotated, each showing one state of the result.

hero.name: Monumental type
hero.what: A very large headline across the width, set tight; the picture as a band below it or cut into the letters.

hero.name: Product window
hero.what: A short headline and buttons above a large product screen that fills the lower half and crops at the fold, so the visitor scrolls into it.

look.name: Soft editorial
look.what: Warm cream or bone ground, espresso ink, a high-contrast serif headline with one italic phrase, a quiet grotesk for text.

look.name: Soft structural
look.what: Near-white or pale silver ground, near-black ink, a confident grotesk headline, one accent colour, soft wide shadows.

look.name: Dark glass
look.what: Deep black ground with one or two very soft colour washes behind the hero, white text at 92%, white/10 hairlines, a wide grotesk.

look.name: Colour field
look.what: One saturated brand colour as the ground of the hero (deep green, cobalt, terracotta, plum) with cream type; the rest of the page on a light ground with that colour as the accent.

look.name: Print mono
look.what: Paper white and true black with one ink colour, visible grid lines and rules, type doing most of the work, like a well-set printed sheet.

look.name: Warm dark
look.what: A dark warm grey or espresso ground with amber or cream accents, soft light falling on the product picture.

type.name: Serif display, grotesk text
type.what: A high-contrast serif headline (Instrument Serif, Newsreader, PP Editorial New or a Palatino cut) with a neutral grotesk for text.

type.name: One grotesk, two weights
type.what: One grotesk family (Geist, Satoshi, General Sans, Plus Jakarta Sans) for everything, headline at 500–600 tracked tight, text at 400.

type.name: Wide grotesk with mono labels
type.what: A wide or extended grotesk headline, a regular grotesk for text, and a mono only for short labels and code.

type.name: Humanist serif throughout
type.what: One readable serif family for headline and text, at different sizes and weights, with a small grotesk only for labels.

type.name: Condensed display
type.what: A condensed or compressed headline face in capitals or sentence case, set large, with a plain grotesk for text.

type.name: Rounded and friendly
type.what: A rounded or soft grotesk headline with generous spacing, for products that should feel warm rather than technical.

buttons.name: Pill with icon circle
buttons.what: Full pills; the trailing arrow sits in its own circle flush with the right padding.

buttons.name: Soft rectangle
buttons.what: 12–14px radius, 48–52px tall, label only, a faint inner highlight on the filled button.

buttons.name: Sharp and solid
buttons.what: 2–4px radius, heavy fill, uppercase or semibold label, like a stamped label; the secondary action is an underlined text link.

motion.name: Staged build
motion.what: The hero builds itself block by block on load; sections rise once as you reach them.

motion.name: Pinned handoff
motion.what: The hero picture stays pinned while the page scrolls and becomes the working demo, or steps through its states.

motion.name: Line-mask reveal
motion.what: Headlines reveal line by line from behind a mask; pictures uncover with a clip-path wipe; everything else is still.

motion.name: Horizontal band
motion.what: One section scrolls sideways as the visitor scrolls down (steps, examples or cases), pinned for at most two screens.
